_doc: Prop library: what the studio can already DRAW. status: built | partial | missing. The director may only choose built props; partial = usable with limits; missing = must be built first (listed in the shot list as NEEDS BUILD).

parcel.how: recipe 'unbox' (stage buy/open): parcel arrives, tape cut, lid off, chip out

rack.how: recipe 'plugin': chip slides into server rack, LED on, RUNNING panel

chip.how: Chip SVG (Everyday.tsx), H100 photo, ProIcon cpu

portrait.how: photos template with real photo: Jensen, Musk, Alice (Reuters), Rubio, Trump, Xi

silhouette.how: compose item p:"person" / card kind:"person" (badge, tie, hat, name tape)

map.how: map template with pins and highlighted countries

route.how: compose item p:"route" (dotted route, moving crates, blocked bar)

entity-map.how: EntityMap: people -> companies -> money with typed links and callouts

stock-chart.how: real NVDA daily closes, draw-on, drop counter, pins

timeline.how: TimelineCards: slim ribbon with dated cards

ban-stamp.how: recipe 'ban': US gov card -> chip -> BANNED stamp -> China

icon.how: 76 ProIcons with draw-on; one icon + label is the WEAKEST visual, use only as a supporting element

flag.how: US and China flags only; Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan flags need the laptop fetch

stat-viz.how: StatPlus: number with objects (bars, servers, dots, ring)

money-flow.how: compose items p:"money" (coins travel + counter) and p:"stack" (coin stack grows)

phone-screen.how: compose item p:"phone" (scrolling feed, real photo thumbnails, header)

courtroom.how: scales used for verdict scenes; gavel prop still missing

corkboard.how: compose items p:"board" + p:"card" + p:"string" (red string between pinned cards)

building.how: compose item p:"building" kind datacenter|tower|office|bank|doj|commerce|treasury|whitehouse|capitol, with sign

clock-calendar.how: compose item p:"calendar" (flips N times with counter)

crowd-petition.how: compose item p:"crowd" (counter + people dots fill)

dinner-meeting.how: compose item p:"table" kind:"dinner" (two silhouettes, candle); kind:"board" = boardroom with raised hands

door-shut.how: compose item p:"door" (crate bounces off a closing door)

scales.how: compose item p:"scales" (beam tilts, labelled pans)

split-compare.how: split card; needs real objects on each side, not words

empty-chair.how: compose item p:"chair" (+ card with away: word to slide the photo out)

rack-missing.how: compose item p:"rack" (slots, missing ones turn into ?)

crates.how: compose item p:"crates" (stack of AI-chip crates, sealed or open)
